boundaries.name: first-rail-finding-is-not-public-authority
boundaries.rule: The cited DIM-07 frequency/span finding, gap CLI output, and portfolio summaries are research-lab evidence only. They do not authorize an engineering study, timetable, procurement plan, advocacy mandate, FRA/Amtrak/state-DOT/host-railroad position, funding instruction, or national construction mandate. Public promotion requires a named release artifact, visible unassessed dimensions, cited corpus/source basis, reproducible run, and full role review.
